## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: very low sector breadth and narrow Top-5 leadership (Leadership: Narrow — 3/5 Technology) alongside mixed large-cap internals (AAPL ABOVE TREND vs NVDA BELOW TREND) support a neutral read.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Healthcare leading: TMO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.14% | 1M: +10.83%), ABBV ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.62% | 1M: +4.87%), ISRG RECOVERY (1W: +8.22% | 1M: -2.06%). Consumer Staples showing steady strength: MO ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.90% | 1M: +11.35%), MNST RECOVERY (1W: +4.04% | 1M: -2.09%). Communication modestly positive: META ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.00% | 1M: +18.34%), GOOGL RECOVERY (1W: +3.70% | 1M: -0.26%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Utilities weakest: VST BELOW TREND (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -3.91%), CEG BELOW TREND (1W: -11.70% | 1M: -6.57%). Financials weak: GS BELOW TREND (1W: -8.83% | 1M: -10.34%), BAC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -8.91%). Industrials under pressure: CAT BELOW TREND (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -11.22%), BA BELOW TREND (1W: -2.16% | 1M: -10.62%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: PANW RECOVERY (1W: +12.10% | 1M: -0.03%), ISRG RECOVERY (1W: +8.22% | 1M: -2.06%), ACN ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.87% | 1M: +11.57%), TMO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.14% | 1M: +10.83%), NOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.64% | 1M: +18.79%). Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology) indicating concentration risk.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: LRCX BELOW TREND (1W: -14.76% | 1M: -21.70%), ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -11.43% | 1M: -2.38%), AMAT BELOW TREND (1W: -11.40% | 1M: -22.32%), GS BELOW TREND (1W: -8.83% | 1M: -10.34%), BAC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -8.91%). Weakness concentrated in semicap/equipment and large-cap financials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W movers: PANW RECOVERY (1W: +12.10% | 1M: -0.03%), ISRG RECOVERY (1W: +8.22% | 1M: -2.06%), ACN ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.87% | 1M: +11.57%). Major divergence: multiple top 1W winners are 1M-negative (PANW, ISRG, MNST), signaling tactical bounces rather than broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Dispersion and pockets of pain: AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.41% | 1M: +8.78%) and QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +14.59%) contrast with NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -4.26% | 1M: -4.83%), ASML BELOW TREND (1W: -7.36% | 1M: -14.92%) and LRCX BELOW TREND (1W: -14.76% | 1M: -21.70%). Technology shows internal rotation, not uniform strength.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials broadly weak: BAC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -8.91%), GS BELOW TREND (1W: -8.83% | 1M: -10.34%), JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.63% | 1M: -3.34%) while V ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +3.37%) and MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.04% | 1M: +0.98%) are isolated bright spots. Sector internals argue for caution on broad exposure.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare outperformance but mixed internals: TMO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.14% | 1M: +10.83%), ABBV ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.62% | 1M: +4.87%), while UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -4.56%) shows pockets of weakness; ISRG RECOVERY (1W: +8.22% | 1M: -2.06%) is a tactical mover. Overall healthcare favored within the neutral regime.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor selective exposure to Healthcare and Consumer Staples while reducing exposure to weak Financials and semicap/equipment Technology names. Monitor RECOVERY signals (PANW, ISRG) as tactical opportunities but treat them as unconfirmed until 1M internals improve.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: TMO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.14% | 1M: +10.83%), ACN ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.87% | 1M: +11.57%), AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.41% | 1M: +8.78%). BEARISH: LRCX BELOW TREND (1W: -14.76% | 1M: -21.70%), AMAT BELOW TREND (1W: -11.40% | 1M: -22.32%), GS BELOW TREND (1W: -8.83% | 1M: -10.34%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W: +0.71% | 1M: -0.88%) and Consumer Staples (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +1.44%) for relative strength. BEARISH: Utilities (1W: -4.24% | 1M: -5.76%) and Financials (1W: -2.39% | 1M: -4.65%); monitor Technology dispersion for follow-through.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch NVDA for failure below recent 1M lows as a confirmation of continued weakness (NVDA BELOW TREND 1W: -4.26% | 1M: -4.83%). AAPL holding above its 1M uptrend (AAPL ABOVE TREND 1W: +5.41% | 1M: +8.78%) would keep tech leadership narrative intact. LRCX/AMAT breaks below current supports would deepen semicap drawdown and pressure related suppliers and OEMs.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
ISRG (+75): EU approval for da Vinci SP — ISRG RECOVERY (1W: +8.22% | 1M: -2.06%) — short-term confirmation, 1M divergence. TMO (+55): stronger demand outlook — TMO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.14% | 1M: +10.83%) — sentiment confirmed. ASML (+50): positive capacity commentary — ASML BELOW TREND (1W: -7.36% | 1M: -14.92%) — sentiment diverging from price, watch for follow-through.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
GS (-55): softer trading warning — GS BELOW TREND (1W: -8.83% | 1M: -10.34%) — sentiment confirmed. BAC (-50): weaker fee guidance — BAC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -8.91%) — confirming weakness. BA (-50): production delay warnings — BA BELOW TREND (1W: -2.16% | 1M: -10.62%) — sentiment aligned with price weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. TMO ABOVE TREND, ACN ABOVE TREND and AAPL ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while NVDA BELOW TREND and LRCX BELOW TREND show material weakness. Key risk: narrow leadership (3/5 Technology) and multiple RECOVERY cases (PANW, ISRG) create divergence — monitor news-confirmation vs 1M internals.
